citations.claim: energy just below limit one step before violation
first violation: energy exceeds allowed 84.2 J

explanation: Three perfectly elastic (e=1) light bodies stacked in contact fall under high gravity (30) with large dt=1/30. Bodies remain in sustained penetrating contact (gap ~ -0.001) with touching pairs at steps 209-210 while bouncing. Impulse + positional correction for resting/penetrating elastic contacts injects net mechanical energy over many steps, drifting from 72 J to >84.2 J (10%+5 tolerance) by step 210 with zero controller work.
vision_note: The strip shows three small blue circles stacked vertically in mid-air, staying in tight contact with almost no movement across steps 207 to 210. No bounce, separation, explosion, walls, waypoints, or red-highlighted violator is visibly apparent despite the reported energy violation.
